newsitem.title: USA: Medical Laser agrees to RF Management buy.
newsitem.headline: Medical Laser agrees to RF Management buy.

text.p: Medical Laser Technologies Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to be acquired by RF Management Corp of Morristown, N.J., for a combination of cash and stock.
Further terms of the deal will not be released until RF Management makes an offer, which is expected to come in two weeks, said Medical Laser Chairman Michael O'Shea.
Medical Laser shares closed Monday at 1/2. RF Management shares were trading at 1-7/16 late Tuesday morning.
Medical Laser makes medical digital imaging equipment. RF Management provides financial and management services to the medical imaging industry, Medical Laser said.
